prompt:
Use case: illustration-story, style-transfer.
Asset type: ONE complete fully OPAQUE square narrative illustration C01-CH01-S00, target native size 1254x1254. It must communicate at 128x128. This is Roderick fastening young Leia's wristguard, a close two-person mentor/apprentice scene, not a loose prop, character card, panorama, collage or battle scene.

REFERENCE ROLES:
Image 1: approved concept-v2 STYLE ONLY: bold dark contours, broad chunky exaggerated shapes, large expressive heads and hands, sturdy anatomy, clean 2–3-tone matte painted/cel planes. Do not copy its troops, river, bridge or overhead view.
Image 2: approved Leia stage01 IDENTITY: same eighteen-year-old woman with chestnut-brown thick side braid, broad dark brows, young expressive face, blue-gray quilted light armor, simple grouped mail edging, blue-gray neck wrap with round silver clasp, plain brown belt. No crown, personal heraldry or later scars. Do not copy the torn gray flag, staff or banner; this scene is earlier.
Image 3: approved Roderick stage01 IDENTITY: same older gray-haired man with swept exposed hair, full gray beard and moustache, strong dark brows, broad practical matte steel shoulder/breast armor and blue-gray scarf/tabard. Keep his exact familiar face and hair shape. No helmet, villain armor or different beard. His hands are free for the task; do not copy the held sword or shield.

STORY-EXACT MOMENT:
Before dawn in a wet border camp after a night of rain, before Leia's first independent command. Roderick patiently reties the too-tight wristguard on Leia's ANATOMICAL LEFT forearm. His old brown LEFT leather glove has a simple large patch at the thumb base. He supports her wrist with that gloved left hand and uses his other hand to form a simple loose-ended quick-release knot in the wristguard's tan leather thong. The blue-gray metal-edged wristguard is visibly WORN ON HER ARM, with her bare hand extending naturally from its cuff. Clearly show the two strap ends and one readable loop being tightened at the wrist, not a handshake, wound dressing, jewelry gift or floating separate bracer. Her right hand stays quietly near her belt. Both characters have intact uninjured hands. This precedes all later battle injuries: NO blood, bandages, cut wrist, shoulder scar or disabled hand.

COMPOSITION:
Intimate waist-up/hip-up square view at human eye level. Roderick on the left leans slightly down toward the work; Leia on the right faces inward, watching his hands with a mix of nervous pride and attention. Preserve the same stylized anatomy as the identity references; she reads as an eighteen-year-old adult apprentice, not a small child. Their two large recognizable heads occupy the upper-middle half, fully inside the canvas with breathing room. The shared wristguard and three working/supporting hands are large and clear in the center-lower area, around x45–60%, y58–72%. Leia's left arm must have an unbroken obvious anatomical connection from her far/right-side shoulder across toward Roderick; no swapped arm or detached hands. Use overlapping bodies and bent elbows naturally but keep every hand readable. Faces, braid, wristguard and tying gesture should form one compact triangle; do not bury the action at the edge. Expressions are quiet and caring, not a grin, embrace or romantic scene.

BACKGROUND:
A very simple cool blue-gray pre-dawn camp, broad dark muted tent shapes and a low dying fire with only a few dark-red embers at a lower corner. A faint low ribbon of pale smoke can sit behind, never across faces or hands. No bright sunrise, roaring flames, elaborate scenery, extra foreground people, crowd, visible flag or heraldry. The setting occupies little space and stays quieter than the figures. There is gentle restrained warm reflected ember light, but clear face/hand readability rather than extreme dark cinematic contrast.

STRICT DRAWING STYLE:
Bold, exaggerated, chunky clean tactical-fantasy cartoon. Crisp thick warm-dark outlines, 2–3 broad matte cel-shaded color planes, simplified big armor plates, 4–6 large braid sections, grouped gray beard locks. Broad quiet surfaces. Use only a few broad quilt divisions and sparse major rivets; never many tiny stitches, chain rings, hair strands or scratches. Match the named reference faces while simplifying surface detail. Palette blue-gray, matte silver-gray, brown leather, muted slate ground, tiny deep red ember accent. No photorealism, shiny plastic, glossy 3D render, grain, canvas texture, stippling, hatching, microtexture, scattered flecks, blurred painterly mush, decorative fantasy symbols, tiny clutter, lettering, logo, watermark, border, vignette transparency or UI.
Fill the entire square with opaque artwork. No cropped heads or hands. Deliver only this one finished image.
